== Biography ==
John was born in 1849. He is the son of [[Glasgow-2385|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Martin-93219|Mary Anne Martin]].

 '''John Martin Glascow''' went onto marry Mary Gibson in 10 Nov 1870, Coleraine, County Offaly, Ireland<ref>https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QGYQ-ZW9Z</ref>
